fi.value: Villa Maija on yksi Hangon tunnetuimmista pitsihuviloista ja avoinna vuoden jokaisena päivänä. Villa Maija tarjoaa loistavan mahdollisuuden nopeaan irtiottoon arjesta. Yöpyminen aidossa 1800-luvun huvilassa Hangon paraatipaikalla on ainutlaatuinen elämys. Tullijohtaja, hovineuvos Frans von Haartman rakennutti Villa Maijan vuonna 1888.

coordinates.notes: Coordinates read literally from the Google Maps link URL stored in the page's LINKS section (not from a fetched external page).

contact.notes: Email/phone cited from p002's 'Hangö Farm majoitustoiminta' (accommodation business) contact block, distinct from the Deli restaurant's separate contact block on the same page.

evidence.excerpt: Villa Maijan vanhat huoneet on saneerattu ylellisiksi puuhuvila-asunnoiksi.

alternatives.reason: Villa Maija could also be classified as a guest house/villa-style lodging rather than self-contained apartments, since the PoC taxonomy has no dedicated 'villa' category; curator judgment needed to pick the closer fit.

categories.notes: PoC taxonomy has no exact 'villa' category. 'apartment' is chosen because the source repeatedly calls the units 'huoneistoja'/'asuntoja' (apartments); category status is always review per policy, never found.

capacity.notes: Villa Maija has 4 apartments (Eastside, Southside, Westside, Upperside). Overall stated guest capacity is 12-19 people depending on group configuration; exact bed count per apartment is not stated on the fetched pages, so 'beds' is left out rather than guessed.

pricing.notes: No nightly/room rate is stated on the fetched pages; rates are presumably set only inside the external Guesty booking engine, which was not fetched. A separate breakfast add-on is priced at 18,50 EUR/person (source p001: 'Aamupala maksaa 18,50 euroa / henkilö.'), but that is an optional extra service, not the accommodation's own room rate, so it is not used to fill this field.

value.notes: Kesäkuu-elokuu (June-August) minimum stay rises to 3 nights; shorter stays may be opened in summer if gaps remain between existing bookings.

evidence.excerpt: Villa Maija on auki vuoden jokaisena päivänä.
Minimi yöpyminen on yksi yö, ja kesällä kesäkuu-elokuu kolme yötä.
